rule.long_duration: All parent class-A events with published tE >= 150 days (75 events)
rule.controls: First 25 of 2272 events with 10 <= published tE < 50 days, sorted by SHA256(ASCII(salt + event_id)); tie by numeric catalog ID
rule.event_id_format: OGLE3-ULENS- followed by four-digit zero-padded integer catalog ID
rule.overlap_policy: Preserve published class-A unique events; retain overlap aliases, do not discard rows with an alias
